title: finding: `create-objectstack` refuses any project name that starts with `blank` ("blank-probe" → "1 object name(s) still carry the template's 'blank_' prefix … This is a bug in the scaffolder"): the stale-prefix check matches the new namespace itself
body:
Filing gate **①**: a product defect with a public door measured and a named landing point. **Class (a):** a user-visible on-ramp failure. `reach:` `create-objectstack <name>`, measured.

Filed by `domain:cli` seat 2 (#22648) · `os-steve` · session `session_01VoSxBQujKLZKPwK2u5ehQ6`, from #15952's dev (`os-dev-report` on #15952, out-of-scope finding 1; PR #22910). ⛔ Not a claim. Lane and grade are triage's.

**Reader who acts:** triage grades it. The landing point is `packages/create-objectstack/src/rewrite-identity.ts`, so a repair reads as `domain:cli`.

## What is measured

On `origin/main` `9fdb12752c`, the repo-built bin, `create-objectstack blank-probe --skip-install --skip-skills`, exits 1 with:

> Scaffolding rewrote the namespace to 'blank_probe' but 1 object name(s) still carry the template's 'blank_' prefix: src/objects/note.object.ts:6 name: 'blank_probe_note' … This is a bug in the scaffolder, not in your input.

The rewrite itself was correct (`blank_probe_note`). Any project name whose namespace starts with `blank` hits this.

## Why

`findStaleNamespacePrefixes(srcDir, 'blank')` (about `:166`) tests each object name with `namePrefixRe('blank', '')` (about `:134`). The rewritten name `blank_probe_note` begins with the OLD prefix `blank_` because the NEW namespace `blank_probe` itself begins with it. So the check reports a correct rewrite as stale.

## Not measured

- The published `create-objectstack` (only the repo-built bin was run).
- Other template namespaces with the same shape: any new namespace that starts with the template's own namespace plus `_`.

## Direction (not a ruling)

The stale-prefix check exempts names that already carry the NEW namespace prefix, so `blank_probe_note` reads as rewritten. The pin is a project name starting with the template namespace (`blank-probe`), scaffolded green. CONTROL: a genuinely stale `blank_note` is still refused.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on this repo, closed included:
- `create-objectstack project name starting with blank stale namespace prefix findStaleNamespacePrefixes false positive`: 32 hits, none on this subject. The nearest are #22659, #22162, #22150, #21370 and #20333 (other blank-template defects) and #19510 (a registry canary).
- CONTROL: the same query returns 5 create-objectstack blank-template cards, so the instrument reaches this family.

Dedupe words: create-objectstack blank prefix; findStaleNamespacePrefixes false positive; namespace rewrite stale prefix; project name blank.
